ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The large box on the left side of the figure is titled “Producers and Consumers”. In the lower-right part of this area, the plant label “Pigeon Berry” can be seen, and above it to the right there is the label “Rock Squirrel” and a squirrel figure. There is an arrow in the figure pointing upward from near Pigeon Berry to Rock Squirrel. Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow pointing to an animal usually indicates that the animal feeds on the organism at the arrow source. Because the arrow in the figure points from Pigeon Berry to Rock Squirrel, rock squirrels feed on pigeon berry.
